name: Can I remove mold from my ceiling myself?

mainEntity.name: Can I remove mold from my ceiling myself?

acceptedAnswer.text: For small, superficial mold patches (less than 10 square feet) on non-porous surfaces, you might be able to clean it yourself with appropriate safety gear and cleaning solutions. However, if the mold covers a large area, has penetrated porous materials like drywall, or you suspect a hidden moisture source, professional mold remediation is highly recommended. Improper removal can spread spores and lead to recurrence or hidden growth.
acceptedAnswer.description: You can clean small surface mold yourself, but larger areas or mold in porous materials require professional remediation to prevent spread and recurrence.
